verdict.rationale: Ente Auth documents a local export/backup feature with automatic daily, password-encrypted backups to a custom location. The official CLI can automate backups and decrypt the Auth export, and docs reference an "Ente plaintext export format", so data can be extracted and taken elsewhere. However, the documented backups are encrypted in Ente's own format. A community report says you cannot easily export to other apps' formats such as Bitwarden or Aegis, which makes leaving harder. This reflects limited interoperability rather than a direct contradiction of a vendor claim. Missing for 10: a documented first-party plaintext/open-format export flow (e.g. standard otpauth URIs), direct export into other authenticators' formats, and independent hands-on confirmation of a full export-and-leave migration.
